members.member: Identifies a tile's alternative in the atlas (if the source is a [TileSetAtlasSource]), and the scene for a [TileSetScenesCollectionSource]. If set to [code]-1[/code], the cell will be erased.

Identifies a tile's coordinates in the atlas (if the source is a [TileSetAtlasSource]). For [TileSetScenesCollectionSource] it should always be [code]Vector2i(0, 0)[/code]. If set to [code]-1[/code], the cell will be erased.
Pattern index in the pattern list of the [TileSet].
Pattern offset used to shift the tiles from the origin (top left corner of the pattern).
A [TileSetSource] identifier. See [method TileSet.set_source_id]. If set to [code]-1[/code], the cell will be erased.
The tile's terrain set in the [TileSet].
Determines how the [TileMapGaeaRenderer] uses this material.

constants.constant: Tile is just a single cell in the [TileSet]. Requires [member source_id] and [member atlas_coord]. Can optionally be an [member alternative_tile].
Tile is a terrain from a terrain set. Allows for autotiling. Requires [member terrain_set] and [member terrain].
Tile is a pattern of cell. Requires a [member pattern_index]. Can optionally define [member pattern_offset].
